what: The Hero wordmark is stacked in four layers in the same spot (the three copies are painted in the background color and hide the layer beneath), and from when the plate top edge touches 25px from the top of the screen, while scrolling by the plate height, the copy layers follow upward without a curve to −24, −48 and −72px — the top layer rises fastest, and below it each layer pulls out a 24px trailing line like stairs

options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Wordmark row to stack in layers (first child of the board) — the part duplicates itself and continues behind
options.step: Extra distance each layer rises (px), default 24 — layer n is step × n
options.offset: Starts when the panel top edge touches this far (+1px) below the screen top (px), default 24
options.--fx-echo-bg: Layer background color (via style), default var(--kf-bg) — it must match the background behind the panel so the lower layers are hidden

note: The original is a Framer scroll transform (transformTrigger onScrollTarget · target ref is the panel itself · offset 24 · anchor point 1px) — over the input range [max(panel top − 1 − 24, 0), panel top − 1 − 24 + panel height], output y runs straight from 0 to −24, −48, −72. No spring, the scroll value is used as is.

from.where: index.html .h-logo hero wordmark — original Logo Wrapper (logo framer-1n3b1vj fixed + clones 1p4k7v7·kjt1zm·cxye33, background #f6fcff · top 50% translateY(-50%), y 0 → −24·−48·−72) · the panel starts at −24px up and transparent, then drops in over .6s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.05,1) (fade-up)
